title: How AI Impacts Skill Formation
abstract: arXiv:2601.20245v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI assistance produces significant productivity gains across professional domains, particularly for novice workers. Yet how this assistance affects the development of skills required to effectively supervise AI remains unclear. Novice workers who rely heavily on AI to complete unfamiliar tasks may compromise their own skill acquisition in the process. We conduct randomized experiments to study how developers gained mastery of a new asynchronous programming library with and without the assistance of AI. We find that AI use impairs conceptual understanding, code reading, and debugging abilities, without delivering significant efficiency gains on average. Participants who fully delegated coding tasks showed some productivity improvements, but at the cost of learning the library. translated_title: 人工智能如何影响技能形成
translated_abstract: AI辅助在各个专业领域带来了显著的生产力提升，尤其对新手工作者而言。然而，这种辅助如何影响有效监督AI所需技能的发展仍不清楚。过度依赖AI完成不熟悉任务的新手工作者可能会在此过程中损害自身的技能习得。我们通过随机实验研究了开发者在使用与不使用AI辅助的情况下如何掌握一个新的异步编程库。我们发现，使用AI会削弱概念理解、代码阅读和调试能力，且平均而言并未带来显著的效率提升。完全将编码任务委托给AI的参与者虽然表现出一定的生产力提升，但代价是未能学会该库。我们识别出六种不同的AI交互模式，其中三种涉及认知投入，即使参与者接受（原文摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）……
tldr: 本研究通过随机实验发现，依赖AI辅助学习新编程库会削弱概念理解、代码阅读和调试能力且平均不带来显著效率提升，但涉及认知投入的AI交互模式（六种模式中的三种）能够保护学习成果。
